result.summary: The image shows a residential and commercial intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk. However, the environment lacks modern safety features like curb ramps, pedestrian signals, or traffic calming measures, leaving pedestrians exposed to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: There are no visible curb ramps at the crossing, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility aids or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corners of the intersection where the crosswalk meets the sidewalk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Intersection
hazards.description: There are no visible stop signs or traffic signals to regulate vehicle flow at the pedestrian crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: The intersection area in the foreground.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing transverse markings to continental or ladder-style markings for better visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a high-visibility continental crosswalk, but lacks a pedestrian refuge island or signalization at this specific crossing point. While sidewalks are present, the long crossing distance across four or more lanes of traffic increases pedestrian exposure to high-speed vehicles.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, spanning the width of the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Signalization
hazards.description: The marked crosswalk is uncontrolled, requiring pedestrians to find gaps in multi-lane traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: At the crosswalk markings in the foreground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (PHB)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide protected crossing intervals for pedestrians on this high-volume road.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a signalized urban intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks, but significant pedestrian safety challenges. Large vehicles and wide turning radii create visibility issues and long exposure times for pedestrians crossing multiple lanes of traffic.

hazards.name: Large Vehicle Obstruction
hazards.description: A large white pickup truck is parked or stopped directly adjacent to the crosswalk, severely limiting sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground, white pickup truck at the crosswalk

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection lacks a median or refuge island, forcing pedestrians to cross the entire roadway in one stage.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles get a green light.
